svg.title: Media Transport Library architecture
svg.desc: Applications connect to the Media Transport Library through Frames, RTP Passthrough and Datagram interfaces. The library holds the Pipeline API, Color Format Conversion, ST 2110 sessions, Control Plane Protocols, Management and the Device Abstraction Layer. It runs on the DPDK PMD or Linux kernel network backend (AF_XDP with an eBPF program), on Linux and Windows, with Intel NIC and DMA hardware.
